changelog:
v2.21.1 优化关联词族匹配逻辑

【优化】
- 关联词族匹配更全面：type 可找到 typist、typical、typewriter、typically
- 词干剥离改为多轮递归：typically → typic → typ，匹配更精准
- 新增词干前缀匹配规则：词干包含关系也能关联（如 type 的词干包含 typ）
- 新增去尾E匹配规则：nature → natural 等通过去E后匹配词干
- 双向匹配：查看 typist 也能找到 type，查看 typical 也能找到 typist
- 关联词上限从12个提升到15个
- 避免误匹配：care 不会关联 carbon，more 不会关联 morning
devNotes: improve getStem to recursively strip up to 3 rounds of suffixes; add stem-prefix matching (min 3 chars) to findWordFamily; add E-stripping matching (min 4 chars) for words ending in 'e'; make all matching case-insensitive; increase max related words from 12 to 15
